newsitem.title: TURKEY: First Iraqi oil loading expected Friday - agency.
newsitem.headline: First Iraqi oil loading expected Friday - agency.

text.p: A Turkish-flagged tanker is expected to begin loading the first Iraqi oil from Turkey's Ceyhan port on Friday, Anatolian news agency said.

It said the 150,000-tonne tanker Gole would probably ship the crude to the Aliaga refinery in the western city of Izmir. Aliaga is owned by Turkey's Tupras refiner which has U.N. approval of a contract to buy 75,000 bpd of Iraqi oil.
A Turkish oil official at Ceyhan had said earlier that the first vessel was likely to arrive on Saturday.
Anatolian said Iraq had pumped 280,000 barrels from Kirkuk to Ceyhan from 1200 GMT on Wednesday until 0600 GMT on Thursday.
Turkish oil officials expect 350,000 bpd of Iraqi crude.
State-owned Tupras declined to comment on Thursday on any shipping plans.
